description: Sigiro ingests OpenTelemetry data and lets users query and inspect telemetry, traces, alerts, and profiles to diagnose what changed in their software. It is available as a hosted service and as a self-hosted binary or container.
summary: sigiro.com exposes one OpenAPI-described HTTP API at `https://sigiro.com`, a self-hosted open-mode variant of the same API on `https://<your-sigiro-host>:9999`, a `sigiro` CLI, and an OAuth-protected streamable-HTTP MCP server at `https://sigiro.com/mcp`.
